parts.title: Turn a promise into a gate
parts.body: A claim such as 'helpful and safe' cannot approve a launch. Define the task population, reference outcomes, failure severity, and thresholds before building. Measure task success, unsupported statements, privacy violations, latency, cost, and the business outcome separately. A pilot can allow human review on every answer; a broad launch may require much stronger evidence because exposure grows.
parts.label: Understand

parts.title: Write a release decision
parts.body: For a knowledge assistant, specify a representative held-out test set, an acceptable rate of unsupported answers, a zero-tolerance list for cross-user data leaks, and a review owner. Report sample size and uncertainty with every percentage. Decide in advance whether a failed safety case blocks launch even if average quality looks good.
parts.label: Apply
